== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Echo Trooper Backpack (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. Compared with the printed card [[Echo Trooper Backpack]]. Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>665c51056014fef02134960bb75f5b7d2d0f59c9</code>.
